notes.title: New Year and a new article about the game's development.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/03f7ad04307827b2e1a735dadb1a221cd8f8f008.jpg[/img]

Greetings, friends! A new article about the development of the Hail to the Rainbow project has been published on Habr, though unfortunately, it is currently only available in Russian. This part focuses on the creation of 3D content, materials, and surface shaders. The previous introductory part, which is available in English, can be found [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/hail-to-the-rainbow/tutorials/hail-to-the-rainbow-game-development-that-lasts-forever]here[/url]. I hope this material will be interesting for those who enjoy exploring the behind-the-scenes aspects of game development.

[url=https://habr.com/ru/articles/870966/]Article.[/url]

Taking this opportunity, I’d like to share an important update regarding the upcoming release. It was initially planned for the first quarter of 2025, but the experience with the demo has shown that such an ambitious project requires more thorough polishing and testing. I want to complete everything without rushing or stress, so the release timeline will need to be slightly adjusted. I won’t provide any estimates at this time to avoid creating false expectations.

Thank you very much for your attention! Wishing you all a Happy New Year and all the best!

notes.title: DEMO Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/bd8f3028b4af9f680b0f6b895f44bc5fc558cee0.jpg[/img]

Hello! An update for the Hail to the Rainbow demo has been released.

   - The new build is optimized for 64-bit OS architecture. This might fix crashes on some systems. If you’re testing the new build and previously experienced crashes, please let me know if the issue is resolved.
  -  An FOV setting has been added (with a maximum limit of 80 for technical reasons). If you've launched the demo before, please check this setting in the menu, as it’s a new variable and might reset.
  -  Key bindings for gear shift and reverse can now be customized. Similarly, if you've played before, it’s worth re-checking this setting.
  -  When the HUD is enabled during the robot fight, the enemy's health bar is now displayed.
  -   The robot's behavior in the second part of the demo is now more predictable.
  -  Ignat’s hands now show bloodstains when health is low and snow effects when outside.
  -  A potential fix for ultra-wide monitor menu display issues has been applied (though it’s hard to confirm without testing).
  -  Crunch compression for textures has been disabled, which might also help with resource loading and reduce crashes. As a result, the build size is now slightly larger (5 GB), but memory and VRAM usage remain the same.

notes.title: CONTEST! (CONCLUDED)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/4d41288b6f2a06bdbc434f3808993e56774b1980.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

As I mentioned earlier, today marks the start of the "Steam Next Fest", and to celebrate, I'm holding a contest where 5 people can win a key to the full release version of the game (originally I mentioned 3 keys, but let's make it more).

The demo has been updated (please make sure to update), and now it includes a new object that wasn't there before in the location. Unfortunately, this contest is more suited for those who have seen the earlier version of the demo. This object is exactly that—an object, not a sound, or text, and it's not in the menu, but on the location itself. You can interact with it in a specific way, and in the end, you will receive an image. This image will appear in the "Materials/Gallery" section of the menu. You need to examine the image (it’s a photo), take a screenshot, and count the number of metal spheres on it.

Send your answers to my email: NoskovFe@mail.ru. Please include the screenshot of the photo and the number of spheres you counted. I will announce the results when 5 participants have sent the correct answer, and this post will be updated.

There are no additional conditions like reposts or subscriptions, but of course, I'd appreciate any [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/][b]wishlists[/b][/url] and visits to my social media.

Thanks, everyone, for your attention, and good luck with the search!


P.S. I didn't mention the photo mode in the demo, but it's there, so feel free to try it out. It’s activated with the P key (but only outside of vehicles and cutscenes).

notes.content:
Greetings, Friends!

I am excited to present the new trailer for the demo version of the game, which will be released on October 11th! As I mentioned earlier, this year I decided to participate in the "Games to Be" festival and have prepared a two-hour segment for this event.

[previewyoutube=r2H0X63n_LI;full][/previewyoutube]


[url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum?z=video-56446165_456239254%2Fvideos-56446165%2Fpl_-56446165_-2]VK version [/url] 

You will be able to fully explore the project and its core mechanics, watch several cutscenes, experiment with the photo mode, and enjoy the wonderful compositions by Nobody's Nail Machine.
 
Since the demo will be released on October 11th and the festival itself begins on the 14th, I have a small request for all those who care – please launch the game once more on the day of the festival after the update. The more player activity we see, the more likely it is that Steam will promote the game and make it more visible.

To motivate you to relaunch, I’m offering a [b]CONTEST[/b] in which three winners will receive a key to the full release! On October 14th, the game will be updated again and ready for the contest. I will provide more detailed rules later (there will be a new post).

I sincerely hope you enjoy this experience and the demo as a whole! All the best to everyone!

notes.title: Announcement of Hail to the Rainbow DEMO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/fdff19f4e587f24b46e97f3c9a87cd0c3c90cd40.gif[/img]

Greetings! I’m breaking the silence to share some exciting news: I’m currently preparing a game demo for the upcoming Steam Autumn Game Festival! After much deliberation, I decided to participate. The demo will feature a section of the game with a playtime of 1.5 to 2 hours. In this episode, players will be able to see several cutscenes and experience some of the core mechanics.

The demo is expected to be released in early October, just before the festival. This is a thrilling moment, somewhat akin to a release, as players will get to see the project with their own eyes for the first time. I originally hoped to finish earlier, but, as is tradition, the polishing process took longer than anticipated.

Unfortunately, I still can't give an exact date for the final release. There are still many unfinished aspects in the project, and I’m working through numerous details and conditions. Given the considerable length of the game, polishing and regular testing are consuming a lot of time and effort. I’m now aiming for a release in the first quarter of 2025. But the end is in sight, which is encouraging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/244dc57694236d35e37bc8bd182330301e1f7108.gif[/img]

A new trailer will be published soon.

Thank you all for your attention!

notes.title: The work is nearing completion!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/4f50fbb48fad5525e5fb4195c08d0527a92628c0.jpg[/img]


Hello! I've been working on "Hail to the Rainbow" for five years now. Crazy timing, especially for an indie. The process is intense and emotionally difficult. With each new game you try to invest more and more, pay attention to details, you want to make everything as perfect as possible, and this makes development time longer

I finally completed the base of the game, finished all the locations, mechanics and started polishing the project. In general, there is still a lot of work, but the finale is already visible ahead. Last week I played the entire project for the first time, from start to finish. [b]Walkthrough took about 10 hours![/b]

Also, the voice acting for the game was recently completed. For the first time in my project there will be English voice acting. In my practice, this is a big and difficult step, I hope, despite the nuances, it will be a pleasant addition for players :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/b4026e8fd69ae839665c7df9c593947373798aa8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to the page of a new game project  "Hail to the Rainbow". This is my fifth author's project, which is currently under development. The game takes place in an alternate universe where advanced technology aimed at improving the lives of mankind has led to its collapse. Ideas about the world of the game appeared in my mind since the time of work on "7th Sector". This universe seemed to me extremely interesting and suitable for deep immersion and explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/532d5e0e1c82a31d6039219064c9f191c916a47f.gif[/img]


"Hail to the Rainbow" is a massive project with great attention to detail. The work has been going on for about 2 years and the final revision will take about the same amount (approximate forecast).


In the meantime, I will be glad for the interest shown and the addition of the game to the wishlist. There is a long way ahead, during which I will try to share materials and best practices. Some content will be published on the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SergeyNoskov]Patreon[/url]  channel.

Good luck to all!
